item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Rock In Rio Lisboa 2026 - Stage Super Bock and Music Valley
item.description:
Olá, Alguém têm esses concertos gravados no Palco Super Bock e Music Valley no Rock In Rio Lisboa 2026 no YouTube?
Estou tentar procurar e não achei da Sofia Camara e Alok. Por favor comentem, obrigado.


Espero que tenha descarregado antes de ser no vídeo privado do canal oficial do Rock In Rio Lisboa.


English:
Hi, does anyone have these shows recorded at the Super Bock and Music Valley stages at Rock In Rio Lisboa 2026 on YouTube?

I've been trying to find them and haven't been able to find the ones by Sofia Camara and Alok. Please comment, thank you.

I hope you downloaded them before they became a private video on the official Rock In Rio Lisboa channel.
Links (went private video - foi no vídeo privado):
